known.title: Not done: measured run coverage mixes rounds, attempts and items

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. The stated 257 of 580 run baseline counts 67 items with no recorded build round as 67 runs. The table’s recorded run categories total 53 build rounds, 412 reviews and 48 cold reads, or 513; adding the 67 items produces 580. It also lists 58 Codex turns and 9 capacity retries separately, while the acceptance criterion measures every attempt. Because an item or round is not an attempt count, the claimed 44% does not establish the required measured token coverage.

why: An engineering manager cannot see what each story, task and fix cost in tokens and time, because Forge loses Codex retry and nudge counts, drops token totals when pull request histories are compacted, and counts nothing for native Claude or Codex agents
